notes.title: Tax-Force DEMO 2.0 Comes to Next Fest
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello Outsiders!

We’re super excited to release the DEMO 2.0 for our upcoming game; Tax-Force, as part of Steam Next Fest![/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Big Boss - 0TT0[/b][/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdZoBuIMlNuxzpl0qvTO0-DrgRufflst0L6XIoOVOeV8hGcVCEBd2-d3EWVncAFqSgZXSf7GxyfORAk01bSjLt27ZGwmC878W8SKJZfqwG-OWJVWSbMLlXqQXYYNsdZdy6N8ZtIeQ?key=LrA6t4cJRMH5MRaH0Fu3mA"][/img][/p][p]The biggest addition to the demo is the inclusion of our first big Tax-Force Boss;[b] 0TT0[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]0TT0 was a piece of early Drill-It mining equipment, abandoned and forgotten early on, lying dormant deep below the surface, listening to the silent vibrations running along its sensors. Learning secrets people would rather have left buried.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]The Target you’re searching for has cut a deal with it for protection, you have to get past 0TT0 to reach negotiations. [/p][p][/p][p]Keeping with the theme of the game, 0TT0’s environmental hazards will change depending on your economic choices.[/p][p][/p][p]Our playtesters have found 0TT0 quite the challenge (except for one tester, who beat the machine on the first attempt!). Comment below to let us know if you managed to beat the robot. [/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]Maximum Heat Weapon Shop - New Specials and Mods[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeoYOYEwMEnyV3rbtljgICZkTAG6dsimzkNA364MRoClhGY93yR391SMt-RAmlAPsB3-jwcfw-R8tr_6LW6VaNGN8QbuJongTR3RV7yA2NqwCxH43JS_QbwiU3B-2dVq32BiqDdlw?key=LrA6t4cJRMH5MRaH0Fu3mA"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]Nzinga Winga brings [b]Maximum Heat [/b]to Farset, offering a bunch of Mods and Specials in the form of mutant abilities, with 3 different Specials available to try out in the demo; [b]Astral Projection, Optical Blasts [/b]and [b]Quickshiver [/b][/p][p][/p][p]With the state of Farset 13’s current economy, Maximum Heat is constantly getting robbed by bandits and gangs - investing in Public Security will offer more choice in every visit, or invest in Private Defence contracts to increase the quality of the limited gear. [/p][p]

[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfd-N3X95xXuraU5A3Bv_fCg8mA3fOkzEZWKnKHeCE5DcSfoAuB1zQi2onQ_M7e2AKrS1jvKCP0ccT57lcvzLSgBKOrQibE1Vv6-1I9sWbxJCptTiXPujQNRieCrd2LnCu6sWMv?key=LrA6t4cJRMH5MRaH0Fu3mA"][/img][/p][p]

[b]On top of these features, we have a host of upgrades including [/b][/p][list][*][p]Big Sound Design overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]New Targets[/p][/*][*][p]Play an extra cycle each run[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We’ve been working hard to expand, improve and polish the gameplay based on your feedback.[b] Give the demo a shot, and help spread the word throughout Next Fest![/b][/p]

notes.title: Announcing Tax-Force - new game!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/22457391/79974ff41dbc2accb3a50341c855c14854c855d4.png[/img]

Announcing…

Tax-Force

Hunt down tax-evading mutant billionaires and reinvest in society in a narrative action rogue-lite and political sim mashup.

Hello everyone, we are super excited to be announcing our new game Tax-Force in advance of demoing at the Indie Arena Booth demo at Gamescom (If anyone is attending, come and say hello)!

We’ve been working away in secret for the last couple of years on we consider our Magnum Opus, which combines the team’s love of 90’s comic books and our disdain for tax-avoiding billionaires.

Our game community is our biggest help on our gamedev journey, so for more info, teaser trailer & screenshots, head over and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2508290/TaxForce/]WISHLIST[/url] on our newly launched

notes.title: Jennifer Wilde: Unlikely Revolutionaries is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/22457391/7ef21a2b0c0d782ac914e48a20891e753958def1.png[/img]

Jennifer Wilde: Unlikely Revolutionaries is finally here! 🥳 😍It’s been a wonderful journey getting us to this point, and we want to thank everyone who’s supported us along the way - including you!

[i]“Jennifer Wilde: Unlikely Revolutionaries is a remarkable game that tackles themes rarely seen in commercial adventures. The writing is superb, with rich and complex characters and interactions.”
[b]Adventure Gamers[/b]

“With its beautiful art design, witty dialogue that draws upon said spirit’s works, and featuring a story that wouldn’t usually be depicted in a game, it’s a standout for me.”

You can pick the game up right [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466350/Jennifer_Wilde_Unlikely_Revolutionaries/]now[/url]!

notes.title: Jennifer Wilde: Unlikely Revolutionaries - release date confirmed!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that Jennifer Wilde: Unlikely Revolutionaries will be released on [b]October 18th 2022! [/b]🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261115/06e5c65e598546ed141a3efdeb249028630a80e5.jpg[/img]

We’re so excited to finally share the game with you, and thank you so much to everyone who’s supported us through the development process. We couldn’t have done it without you!

With the finish line in sight, it’s your time to shine! It would really help us if you could share the game on your social media accounts, talk to your friends about it, and generally help us get the word out as much as possible. Don’t worry if you don’t feel you have much of a platform - every little helps!

You can also help support the game in this final stretch by following Outsider Games on social media, if you don’t already. You can find us at the following links:

Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/OutsiderGames]@OutsiderGames[/url]
Instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/outsidergames/]@OutsiderGames[/url]
Facebook: [url=https://www.facebook.com/OutsiderGames]Outsider Games page[/url]
Or join the Discord server [url=https://t.co/X5SNQaw9lJ]here[/url].

We can’t wait to bring Jennifer Wilde into the world, thank you all again for your support.

See you in October 😱🤩

Stephen and the Outsider Games team

notes.title: New Track! Wailing Height's Indie band - The Aos Sí - album for Pre-order
notes.notes:
James Downey and the Aos Sí, who you will recognise as the singing voices of [b]Leg End[/b] and [b]Ada Z and the Zom Bs[/b], have put their own indie album up for pre-order on [url=https://itunes.apple.com/gb/album/james-downey-and-the-aos-s%C3%AD-ep/id1269324322]iTunes[/url], Amazon UK and Bandcamp.  

Thanks to popular demand, they're also going to let us add their new recording of Dancing Through Eden, the song played outside the Cremetary, to our soundtrack DLC as a free update! 

I've heard the album and it's pretty amazing. The DLC will be updated sometime after their release on Sep 1, but you can listen to a preview of Dancing Through Eden on their [url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/James-Downey-Aos-S%C3%AD/dp/B074NBSBBP/ref=sr_1_1?ie=UTF8&qid=1502709092&sr=8-1&keywords=james+downey+and+the+aos+si]Amazon[/url] page.

notes.title: Nominee for Best Script at the Zebbie Awards!
notes.notes:
Congratulations to Kevin Beimers on being nominated for Best Game Script by the Writer's Guild of Ireland for his work on Wailing Heights! 

We didn't win the overall prize, that honour went to Little Acre (another great adventure game you should check out), but a great night was had by all. 

[img]http://www.wailingheights.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/DSC_0531.jpg[/img]

To celebrate, we're thinking of formatting and releasing Kevin's original Wailing Height's script as DLC, alongside our long-awaited game update (coming very soon!)

Anyone interested in reading the original script to see how the whole story came together?

notes.title: Good News, Not So Good News
notes.notes:
Well, the Good News, is that we got our hands on the final remastered audio files a week or so back, and they are sounding great.

The Not So Good News, is that while updating the game and SDK, the compatibility of the lighting system broke, and everything in the game is very, very shiny. 

The other Good News, is that we've almost fixed the lighting, and although it's taken us a little longer than expected, the remastered update shouldn't be too far away.

Bear with us just a tiny bit longer and your ears and eyes will thank us!

notes.title: AGGIE awards, Upcoming Update!
notes.notes:
I know we've been quiet of late, but we've been very noisy behind the scenes prepping our audio remaster. 95% of the files have been reenginered, and we just to need to record a few missing files in order to set the update live. Shouldn't be too long!

In other news, Adventure Gamers placed us Runner Up in their 2016 Aggie awards for Best Gameplay and Best Music, and we placed as a finalist in the first NI Game of the Year awards.
The NI grand prize went to Her Majesty's Spiffing, which is an adventure game from our chums at Billy Goat that I highly recommend while you're waiting to play the remastered Wailing Heights again.

In other news, development is going well on our new project Jennifer Wilde, and I'm sure we'll be teasing a few new images from that soon, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Added
notes.notes:
We've added a set of Steam Trading cards to Wailing Heights, along with unlockable backgrounds, emoticons and badges.

We should have another update to the build in the not-too-distant future, and if anyone can help spread the word in the meantime, it would be much appreciated!

notes.title: Patch Notes 05.04.2016
notes.notes:
Latest patch includes:

[*] Song Audio balancing - 'Make it Stick', 'Euphoria' volumes lowered to match surroundings
[*] Bug Fix - Finale now plays correct songs
[*] Easier to pick up [spoiler] Spotlight in Souless Saloon [/spoiler] 
[*] Bat can no longer fly through Town Hall ceiling
[*] Pre-selected dialogue text is no longer blurry at lower resolutions
[*] Other small big fixes.

Further dialogue audio level fixes to come.

notes.title: Wailing Heights Launching April 27th - With Cover Song Contest
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.wailingheights.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/WailingHeightsLogo.png[/img]

[b]Wailing Heights[/b], our body-hopping, musical adventure game is singing it’s way to Steam on [b]April 27th 2016.[/b]

Since the game features original songs and puzzle-based lyrics from folk-singing werewolves, 60s Rock and Roll Monsters bands, hipster Vampires and soulful zombies, to celebrate the launch, we're holding a [b]cover-song contest.[/b]

To enter, post a Youtube video of you performing a cover-version of a song from the game, post it on our Wailing Heights Steam Community Hub, or tweet your link to @Outsidergames, before Friday 20th May, and our favourite will win a [b]£100 Steam Voucher.[/b]

With the songs in the game ranging from pop-tastic professional tunes, to ridiculous werewolf limericks in the Full Moon Club, you don’t even have to be a brilliant singer to take part! It’s our favourite that wins!  

To get you started here are the lyrics to ‘Here Come the Deadbeats’, and you can hear the full track performed over our Wailing Heights Trailer on the game page.

[b]We are the Deadbeats[/b]

Verse
You’ll hear us coming,
In the dark of night,
If you catch a sight of us,
You may die of a fright


Chorus
We are the Deadbeats,
Should be resting 6 foot in the ground,
But we’re here to play our music,
We can’t stop sharing our sound

Verse
Get ready for adventure,
We’d love to sing for you,
And if you let us bite you,
You can be a Deadbeat too!


Repeat Chorus and Verse 2

We are the Deadbeats!
